name: @mktask/platform
description: mktask Platform - Open Source Project Management with Conversational AI Task Execution
author: mktask Team

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:fast: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend:fast" "npm run dev:backend:infra"
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.dev:infra:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop postgres redis
scripts.dev:backend:local: dotenv -e .env -v QUEUE_BACKEND=better-queue -v QUEUE_ENABLE_FALLBACK=true -- npm run start:dev --workspace=backend
scripts.dev:backend:infra: dotenv -e .env -v DATABASE_URL=postgresql://mktask:mktask@localhost:5435/mktask -v REDIS_HOST=localhost -v REDIS_PORT=6379 -- npm run start:dev --workspace=backend
scripts.start:dist: npm run build:dist && shx cp .env dist/.env && cd dist && npm run prisma:generate && npm run start:prod
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && shx rm -rf node_modules dist out .next
scripts.docker:build:dev: docker build -f Dockerfile.dev --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) -t mktask:dev .
scripts.docker:build:prod: docker build -f Dockerfile.prod --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) -t mktask:latest .
scripts.docker:push:dev: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -f Dockerfile.prod --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) -t mktask/mktask:dev -t mktask/mktask:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")-dev -t mktask/mktask:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) --push .
scripts.docker:push:stable: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -f Dockerfile.prod --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) -t mktask/mktask:latest -t mktask/mktask:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -t mktask/mktask:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) --push .
